rules: No external asset enters Approved without a manifest entry and license evidence.
Editorial-only, non-commercial, no-derivatives, unknown-license, ripped film/game assets, and trademark/IP copies without separate clearance are blocked.
Reference-only sites may inform original production work but their images/models/audio are not imported unless separately licensed.
Attribution-required assets must carry creator/title/source/license/attribution text in this manifest.
Paid/subscription assets require proof that the project/user account actually holds the applicable game-use entitlement.
External assets may not override story/canon guards, low-spec budgets, or Unreal 4.27.2 compatibility.

providers.notes: For UE4.27 use Fab in Launcher Add to Project/Create Project/Install Plugin where applicable. In-editor Fab integration is UE5.3+.
Use only assets actually acquired/entitled for this project/account; legacy acquisitions keep their applicable legacy terms.
CC BY requires attribution; editorial/NC/ND assets are blocked for production.
Model must be embedded in the game and not exposed as an extractable/open stock asset.
Review the exact item license before acquisition; do not assume all listings permit the same game-use rights.
GDC bundles are suitable for game/media use under their bundle license; keep bundle/version evidence.
CC BY requires attribution. Prefer CC0 for low-friction production.
If used, preserve required attribution and verify the exact track license at acquisition time.
Do not ingest until the exact game-use entitlement/subscription coverage is verified.
Game licensing is available, but entitlement must be verified for the project before ingest.
Use concept art as inspiration/reference only unless the specific work is separately licensed.
Use for chronology/factual research and source pointers; do not import fair-use images/maps or copy protected text into the game.
Use for secondary research only; verify important canon facts against primary/authorized sources where practical.

Weta Workshop is a world-class design/game-development/private-commission partner, not a blanket stock-asset license for Middle-earth. Any use of project imagery/designs still requires rights clearance; Weta itself notes some project material is not its IP.
HDRIs, textures and 3D models are CC0; strong low-friction source for environments and lighting.
Materials/textures are CC0; suitable for terrain, stone, wood, plaster and environmental surfaces.
Useful for auto-rigging and animation. Game use is permitted under current terms; raw character/animation files must not be redistributed as standalone assets.
Useful for actors/motions/props and Unreal export; exact content license and any required mass-distribution rights must be verified per purchase.
Good for UI/prototyping/development assets; use item license metadata and prefer CC0 packs.
